National Sports Day marked with multi‑sport events across Kashmir and Punjab

On National Sports Day, several events were organized in different parts of India. The Jammu and Kashmir Government Association (JKMGA) held a multi‑sport program in Miran Sahib, citing the legacy of Major Dhyan Chand. The University of Kashmir (CU Kashmir) conducted a ceremony honoring athletes and sports participants. Cyclists gathered in Ludhiana for a ride to mark the day. Additional community‑based sports and team‑building activities were reported in various locations. The coverage did not mention any controversies or cancellations.
